title: Paid API Workflows: Control Retries, Deduplication and Credit Costs
checks: Record submission, retained response, validation, delivery and acknowledgment separately
A local fingerprint is not server idempotency
Inspect ledger and destination before repeating uncertain work
Budget calls/pages/runs with explicit price assumptions
Keep a pending queue and acknowledge only confirmed deliveries
Use destination stable keys; do not promise distributed exactly-once delivery
Keep credentials outside workflow exports and prompts
